title: Eight Marbles Race Through a Haunted Castle Marble Run to Escape Giant Hungry Spiders
excerpt: Jelle's Marble Runs presented a Halloween-themed competition in which marbles had to navigate a perilous, haunted-castle course.
content:
Jelle Bakker of Jelle’s Marble Runs presented a spooky Halloween-themed competition in which eight marbles had to navigate a perilous, haunted-castle course with traps, moving obstacles, and ominous creatures, such as giant spiders. As in previous races, the marbles competed in a series of elimination rounds to see which one could safely navigate the course and claim the Halloween championship title.

8 marbles must roll through a spooktacular course full of tricky traps over 8 rounds. From round 4 onwards, the marble with the fewest points gets gobbled up by the giant spiders. Who will have the guts to make it to the final round? Don’t lose your marbles, and don’t get caught in the web!

Commentator Greg Woods calls the action in a suitably spooky voice, naming each trap along the way, from the “Skull Swinger” and the “Boo Basher” to a gang of evil snails known as “Scary Gary”.
